newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Coca-Cola sees Venezuela sales skyrocketing in yr.
newsitem.headline: Coca-Cola sees Venezuela sales skyrocketing in yr.

text.p: Coca-Cola expects its Venezuelan sales to increase to 220 million crates from 15 million crates over the next year, company President Roberto Goizueta said.
"There's a lot of space to grow," Goizueta told reporters.

Coca-Cola captured the Venezuelan market in a surprise move in mid-August when local bottler Embotelladora de Venezuela switched from packaging Pepsi to Coke. Pepsi had previously enjoyed an 85 percent market share in Venezuela.
